title: Oporavak, DR, BC i fizička sigurnost
summary: Strategije oporavka (backup, immutable i offsite kopije, HA, RAID, cold/warm/hot lokacije), DR procesi i metrike (RTO/RPO/MTD, MTTR/MTBF), testiranje DRP-a, BC vježbe, fizička sigurnost i bezbjednost osoblja.
title_en: Recovery, DR, BC and Physical Security
summary_en: Recovery strategies (backup, immutable and offsite copies, HA, RAID, cold/warm/hot sites), DR processes and metrics (RTO/RPO/MTD, MTTR/MTBF), DRP testing, BC exercises, physical security, and personnel safety and security.
